title: Maharashtra Right to Information (Amendment) Rules, 2012
issuer: Government of Maharashtra, General Administration Department
excerpt: A request must relate to one subject matter and ordinarily must not exceed 150 words; separate applications are required for additional subjects.
notes: The official circular index and PDF establish this as a pre-2026 amendment. Legal/RTI approval remains pending.
